name: DLSS 4 Upscaler (WIP)
author: Echo-Storm
description: Work in progress. Upscales with NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler, on every frame it presents, real and generated: choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen. NVIDIA's DLSS runtime is included. It works beside DLSS 5 Neural Rendering.
